author_or_account: Harvard Joint Center for Housing Studies
title: Housing Affordability Crisis Worsens Amid Economic Uncertainty
discussion_signal: The post connects record housing cost burdens with weaker household growth, reduced mobility, high purchase costs, and underfunded assistance. It presents housing as a place-and-life-course constraint rather than only a market-price problem.
linked_research_question: How do housing discussions connect affordability, household formation, mobility, and the capacity of public assistance to absorb place-based pressure?
limits: The post is not a new housing-market sample
It does not establish causal effects of immigration or labor-market changes
